coordinates: Source pixels, 480 by 360. Nose center and tail-fin center were annotated on the opening and closing poses. Values between keys interpolate linearly.
method: Opening head uses an ellipse, then longitudinal body ordering. Side fins outside the head/body core are delayed until 68–92% progression; pelvic fins until 90–98%. Closing uses continuous nose-to-tail projection: attached dorsal and lower fins disappear with their adjacent body; the trailing tail disappears last. Extra keyframes cover portal poses at supported playback rates through3x. This is an authored spatial reveal map, not recovered depth or synthesized fish movement.
